entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this jersey I bought. It's absolutely ridiculous. I've never had a company with such terrible sizing!
I'm very sorry to hear that you're unhappy with the fit. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey?
What's the issue? The issue is it's the wrong size! I ordered my usual large and this thing is so tight I can barely breathe in it. This is unacceptable.
I understand your frustration. A proper fit is essential. I can definitely look into starting an exchange or a return for you. Do you have your order number handy?
It's 8675309. Look, I don't have time for a runaround. Your website says 90 days. I'm within 90 days. Just process the return. If you can't do that, get me a manager who can.

I can certainly handle this for you, no need for a manager. One moment while I pull up that order... Okay, I see it here. You purchased the Pro-Line jersey 23 days ago. You're absolutely correct, that item falls within our 90-day return window.
So you're going to fix it? No excuses?
Of course. Since the current jersey is too tight, I can process a return for a full refund, or we can set up an exchange for a larger size, if you'd prefer. The choice is yours.
Oh. Fine. Just... just do the refund. I'll find something else. Send me the return label.

You got it. I have just processed the return authorization. An email with a pre-paid shipping label and instructions is on its way to your inbox right now. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a better rest of your day.
